params.prompt: A real vertical aerial photograph taken from the same viewpoint as the first attached image, reframed tall: Mount Rainier huge in the upper third with its glaciers glowing pink and gold, the rolling foothills and dark evergreen forest across the middle, and the whole small Pacific Northwest town (street grid, rooftops, tree-lined streets, fairgrounds and open fields) filling the lower half; the second attached image shows the real photographic look of the mountain's north face. The last twenty minutes before sunset in late summer: low warm sunlight from the right raking across the rooftops with long shadows, the sky clear and deepening to blue, the air perfectly clear, no haze, no fog, no blur, every rooftop sharp. Photoreal, full-frame camera, 35 mm, f/8, like a high-quality photograph, never a 3D render or a map; no text of any kind, no titles, no overlays, no logos, no watermark, no people.
